notes.title: Patch Notes 5/29/19
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted file to prevent false positives in some antivirus software
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Improved Controller Support
notes.notes: C. Kane's controller support has been updated and should be far more functional than before. No more need to go into calibration to get it working! Please let me know if you notice anything abnormal (other than the talking beavers and skeletons) while playing with a controller.

notes.title: Update now available
notes.notes: A small update is now available that makes some minor quality of life improvements and cleans up the menus a little. A new option has been added to toggle between fullscreen and windowed from within the game's main menu and a controls screen has been added.
